headline: Zero committed, evidence-backed Mall@Reds products exist in the repository. The only Mall@Reds product data anywhere in git is 37 rows of manual/placeholder CSV on two UNMERGED branches, of which just 2 rows claim any verification and 26 are explicitly marked DO-NOT-APPLY. The schema has no image, SKU, or GTIN columns at all. The shopper path applies no evidence or freshness gate, so trustworthiness of what a real shopper sees depends entirely on unaudited live-DB contents.
